content: Toi ḍõr imame Stifanore fusar goijje, "Ei hota ki soiyi ne?"

Zuwabe Stifane hodde: "Oh ãr báiyain edde baf okkol ãr hota funo! Ãrar fordada Ibrahim Harran šohorot bošoti loibar age zẽtte Mesofotemiya dešot aššil, hẽtte fohoraiwala Allaye hibare deha diyore hoil,
'Tui tor nizor deš edde tor egena gušti feli ãi tore ze deš dehaiyum heṛe zagoi.'
"Toi hiba Kalaḍiya okkolor deš felai Harran šohorot gil edde heṛe bošoti loil. Ar hibar baf mori bade, Allaye Ibrahimore ei dešot defeṛail, zeṛe tũwara ehon bošoti goror.

Allaye hibare nizolla hono zobin no de, enki ekkan ṭeng raki farefan zaga o no, kintu hibaye wada goijjil ze hibare edde hibar bade hibar bongšor manuš okkolore hitarar miraz hisabe he dešore dibo, zodi o he šomot Ibrahimottu hono fuwain no aššil.
Allaye hibare endilla hoil: 'Tor bongšodor okkol bidešot bošobaš goribo. Manuš okkole hitarare gulam banai rakibo edde sair šot bosor dori hitarar uwore zulum salaibo.'
Allaye aro hodde, 'Kintu ze zatiye hitarare gulam banaibo ãi hitarare šasti diyum. Bade hitara he dešottu niyoli aiyore ei zagat ãr ebadot goribo.'

Tarfore Allaye Ibrahimore wadar suktir sinno hisabe azomi goraibar niyom dil, bade hiba Isakor baf oiye edde ašṭo dinor din hibare azomi gora oiye. Hendilla Isake Yakubore edde Yakube he baro gušṭir baf okkolore azomi goraiye.
"He baro bongšor baf okkole riš gori Yusufore gulam hisabe Mišor dešot besifelail. Kintu Allah hibar fũwati aššil,

edde har duk hošṭottu hibare uddar goijje. Allaye hibare giyan dan goijjil edde Mišor dešot razar bala nozorot felabail. Hetolla he razaye hibare Mišor dešor šašon goroya edde razar nizor gór dehafuna goriballa buwail.
"Tarfore Mišor agagura edde Kenanot raṭ deha dilo, edde beši ḍõr hošṭo hazir oiye hetunot ãrar bafdada okkole haiddo lot no fail.
Kintu Mišorot gĩyu ase funi Yakube ãrar bafdada okkolore foila bar heṛe defeṛaiye.
Dusora bar zẽtte hitara aišše Yusufe hibar báiyaindore sin diye edde razaye Yusufor górwala okkolor babute zani faijje.
Iyar bade, Yusufe hibar baf Yakub edde góror gušṭi ṭiya, muṭ hoittor fãszon, beggunore ḍaki anibolla hóbor defeṛaiye.
Tarfore Yakub lami Mišor dešot gil, zeṛe hiba edde ãrar bafdada okkol entehal goijje.
Hitarare Šekimot ana oiye edde ze hoboror gãt Ibrahime Šekim šohoror Hamoror fũwain okkolottu rufa diyore kini loil, hibat dohon gora oil.
"Ibrahimor hãse Allaye ze wada goijje hin furon oibar ṭaim zehon hãse aišše, hetunot deha zadde ãrar manušzon okkol kub beši bari giyegoi.
Tarfore Mišor dešot en 'ekzon noya badša oiye, ze Yusufor babute kissu no zanito.'

He badšaye ãrar manuš okkolore ṭokaito edde ãrar bafdada okkolor uwore zulum goitto, enki hitarattu ze futziyain okkol zormo oito hitara mori zagoifan he gura fuwain okkolore baire felai rakibolla zur gorito.
"He šomot Musa zormo oil. Musa Allar šanot ekzon beši šundojja fuwa aššil. Hibare tin maš foijjonto baf mar górot lalon falon gora oil.
Bade zẽtte hibare baire felai raka oiye, hẽtte razar ziye tuli loizaiyore hibare nizor fuwa hisabe lalon falon goijje.
Mišoriyo okkolor har giyane en bafe šikkita oiye, hiba hotaye edde hame šoktišali aššil.
"Musar umor sališ bosor oiyede šomot hibaye Israili báiyain okkol loi deha goitto zaibo faisela loil.
Ar heṛe Mišoriyo ekzone hitarar ekzonore horaf bebohar goredde Musaye deikke, toi hibaye ei Israili manušwar foikka oibolla giye edde he Mišoriyo manušware marifelaiyore hiyanor daiya loiye.
Musaye mone gojjil hibar nizor manuš okkole buzibo ze Allaye hibar duwara hitarare uddar goribo, kintu hitara hiyan buzi no fare.
Tarforor din Musaye duizon Israilire mara mari goredde deikke. Hetunot hitarare milai dibolla hodde, 'Oh báiyain, tũwara to bái bái, to kiyolla ekzone ekzon loi endilla horaf bebohar goror?'
"Kintu ze manušwaye horaf bebohar goijjil hite Musare ḍeikka mari lorai diyore hodde, 'Ãrar uwore tore šašon goroya edde bisarhar hone tuille?
Gelde hailla zendilla gori he Mišoriyo manušware mari felaiyos, ãre o ki hendilla gori mari felaito sos?'
Ei hota funi Musa dai zaigoi Midiyan dešot musafer hisabe bošobaš gora šuru goijje. Heṛe hibattu duizon morod fuwain zormo oil.
"Sališ bosor farai zaigoi bade, Sinai faharor ḍake bošoti sara elehat maze ek firistaye ek zolonto zaḍḍowar oinor butottu Musare deha diye.
Musaye dekiyore tajjuf oil. Hibaye aro hãse zai saibolla zehon giye, hetunot Mabudor abaz fuinne:
'Ãi tor fordada okkolor Allah, Ibrahim, Isak edde Yakubor Allah.' Kintu Musaye ḍore hafa šuru goijje, hikka saibolla o himmot no gore.
"Hetunot Mabude hibare hodde, 'Tor ṭengor zuta kulifela, kiyollahoile ze zagat tui tiyaiyos hiyan Paki zaga.
Mišor dešot ãr bonda okkolor uwore ze zulum or hin ãi dekki. Ãi hitarar hatoranir ḍak funni edde hitarare uddar goribolla ãi nise lami aišši. Ehon ãi tore Mišor dešot uwafes defeṛaiyum.'

"Iba oilde he Musa zare Israili okkole en hoi batil goijjil, 'Tore šašon goroya edde bisarhar hone banaiye.' Ze firistaye he zaḍḍowar butottu Musare deha dil, he firistar duwara Allah nize ei Musare Israili okkolor šašon goroya edde uddar goroya hisabe Mišorot defeṛail.
Ei Musaye Mišor dešottu Israili okkolore niyolai loi ainnil edde Mišor dešot, louwor doriyar ḍake edde sališ bosorfan bošoti sara elehat bout keramot edde sinnor ham okkol goijjil.
"Iba oilde he Musa ze Israili okkolore hoil, 'Allaye tũwarar nizor báiyain okkolor butottu tũwaralla ãr ḍoil ekzon nobi tiya goraibo.'

Ei Musa bošoti sara elehat maze Israili okkolor dolor butore, ãrar fordada okkolor fũwati aššil. Ze firistaye Sinai faharottu hota hoil ei Musaye he firistar fũwati heṛe aššil. Ãrare dibolla hibaye zinda kalam fail.
"Kintu ãrar fordada okkole Musare mainto no sa. Hiyanor bodole hitara hibare batil goijjil edde hitarar dil Mišoror uzu oigilgoi.
Hitara Harunore hodde, 'Ãrare fõt dehai loi zai farefan dev devi banao, kiyollahoile ze Musaye Mišor dešottu ãrare niyolai loi ainne hibar ki oiye ãra hoi no fari.
He ṭaimot maze hitara gorur so ḍoil gori uggwa mutti tiyar goijje. Hitara he muttir mutallek zanuwar kurbani goijje edde nizor hate banaiyede hiyanor uwore hitara kušir mela goijje.
Kintu Allaye hitarattu muk firai felaiye edde asmanor san šurzo edde tara fũzat maze hitarare felai raikke, zendilla nobi okkolor kitabot leka ase:

content.text: "'Oh, Israil zati, bošoti sara elehat he sališ bosorfan
tũwara ki ãr mutallek hono zandar kurbani ba hadiya dila ne?
No, no do, bolke tũwara to Mulok devotar mutti,
ar Rifon devotar tara, tũwara bar gori boi loi gila,
fũza goribar niyote he mutti okkol banaila.
Kintu ãi tũwarare Babilonor okule felai diyum.'

content: "Bošoti sara elehat ãrar fordada okkolottu uggwa ṭambu aššil zibaye Allah hitarar fũwati aššilde forman diye. Allaye Musare zendilla gori hokum dil edde Musare ze nomuna dehail he mozin ei ṭambu tiyar gora oil.

Ãrar fordada okkol he ṭambu faiyore hitarar neta Yosbar anḍare hiyan hitarar fũware ei dešot loi aššil. Allaye hitarar sarmottu oinno zatire lorai dil edde hitara ei deššan adai goijjil. Daudor ṭaim foijjonto he ṭambu ei dešot aššil.
Hibaye Allattu rahamot fail edde ejazot dibolla foriyad goijjil zene Yakubor bongšolla ekkan dórmogór hibaye tiyar gori fare.
Kintu Soloimane hiballa ekkan dórmogór tiyar goijjil.
"Zen oibo ok, šorbo šoktiwala Allah manušor tiyari górot no take, zendilla nobiye hor:

content.text: ar duniyai ãr ṭeng rakibar zaga.
Ãlla tui hondilla gór tiyar goribi,
Zaga hiyan hoṛe, zeṛe ãi zirai faijjum?
Ei šob ziniš beggun ki ãi nizor hate foida no gori ne?'

content: "Oh ek gũwaijja zati! Tũwarar han edde dil Oihudi okkolor ḍoil, ar tũwara o tũwarar fordada okkolor ḍoil. Tũwara šob šome Pak Ruhure bad di tako.

En hono ki nobi ase, zare tũwarar fordada okkole zulum no gore? Hitara hitarare mari felail, zara agottu loti he niyaiwala aibar babute tobolig goijjil. Ar ehon tũwara hibar loi dúha bazi goijjo edde mari felaiyo.
Firista okkolor duwara tũwarar hãse to ain diya oil, kintu tũwara hin falon no goro."
Stifanore fattor mara oiye
Ei hota okkol funi hitara guššaye oin oi giyegoi edde Stifanor berudde dat loi dat kirkiraiye.
Kintu Stifane, Pak Ruhuye furaiya oi behostor mikka sai taikke edde heṛe Allar mohimar deha faiye. Hibaye Isare Allar den ḍakottu tiyai taikkede dekiyore,
Stifane hodde, "So, ãi behosto kula asede dekir edde Adomor Fut Allar ḍen ḍakottu tiyai roiye."
Henot hitara hanot õl diye edde zure guzoriyore beggune Stifanor uwore zafai foijje.
Bade hitara Stifanore fattor maribolla ṭani šohoror bar kule loigiye, ar goba okkole hitarar zubba okkol gattu kuli Šaulus name ek zuwan fuwar ṭengor ḍake eijje.
Hitara Stifanore fattor maredde šomot, hibaye munazat goijje edde hodde, "Malik Isa, ãr ruhure gosi lo."
Tarfore hibaye ãṛu felaiye edde ḍõr gori guzojje, "Malik, itarar berudde ei gunare monot no raikko," ei hota hoi hiba zurai giyegoi.
